  - region "Simple English explanation of Distance / Length":
    - paragraph: In simple English
    - heading "Understand Distance / Length" [level=2]
    - paragraph: "Distance or length is the straight-segment measure √((x2−x1)^2+(y2−y1)^2). From (1,4) to (4,8) the legs are 3 and 4 so d=5. Length is never negative. A useful rule is Distance formula: d=sqrt((x2-x1)^2+(y2-y1)^2). You can learn Distance / Length by trying one small example instead of long theory."
    - paragraph: Subtract coordinates, square, add, take the square root, and report a non-negative value. Try the example below. Write your steps and choose an answer before opening the comparison.
    - paragraph: "In real life, map distance: A straight route has a length. Watch out: Reporting a negative length. Distance and length are never negative."
